questions.prompt: The Gutenberg press was developed in which century?
questions.fact: The press appeared around 1450, and within fifty years there were printing shops across Europe.

questions.prompt: Which organ filters waste from the blood?
questions.fact: They filter the body's entire blood supply around 30 times a day, and most people manage perfectly well on one.

questions.prompt: How many pieces does each player start a game of chess with?
questions.fact: Sixteen each: eight pawns, two rooks, two knights, two bishops, a queen and a king.

questions.prompt: Which film features the character Hannibal Lecter?
questions.fact: Hopkins is on screen for about 16 minutes, one of the shortest performances ever to win the Best Actor Oscar.

questions.prompt: Which country is located at the southern tip of Africa?
questions.fact: It has three capitals — Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein — splitting the executive, legislature and judiciary.

questions.prompt: Which Shakespeare tragedy is set in Denmark?
questions.fact: It is Shakespeare's longest play, and Elsinore is a real castle at Helsingor.

questions.prompt: Which company introduced the first iPod?
questions.fact: It held 1,000 songs in 2001, when rival players held a few dozen.
